classes.kotoba-glue: calls a Kotoba-emitted object and uses no inline asm itself
classes.needs-intrinsic: uses inline asm directly; every mnemonic has an Amu kernel intrinsic
classes.unresolved-instruction: uses inline asm with at least one mnemonic that has no Amu kernel intrinsic
classes.privileged-via-helper: no asm of its own, but calls a C helper that uses inline asm
classes.c-logic: plain C: no asm, no Kotoba object call, no privileged helper
classes.asm-entry: a .S global symbol (entry, stub or trampoline code)

scope: source text inventory; no build, QEMU or hardware observation; classes are heuristics
